en.title: raltegravir: Table 2 and Table 2 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: Table 2 reads “at least 4 weeks of age and weighing 3 kg to less than 25 kg”. Table 2 reads “weighing at least 2 kg”. Example: A child aged 5 weeks who weighs 2.5 kg has no row in Table 2. The text is in this label.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
